body.name: Distinct-protocol cost \(\operatorname{Cost}(E)\)
body.construction: \(\operatorname{Cost}(E_0)=\sum_{S\in\operatorname{Prot}(E_0)}\sum_{a\in S}c(a)\) for a generic acquired collection, and identically with \(E\) for a uniform certificate, where \(\operatorname{Prot}\) contains each distinct acquired protocol mask once irrespective of its number of slices, sources, or factors.
